articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Why The Narrative Around Hershey (HSY) Is Shifting As Cocoa Relief Meets Demand Questions. Hershey's fair value estimate has been nudged up to about US$194.35 from roughly US$191.95, a small move that reflects shifting views on how easing cocoa and tariff costs stack up against questions about demand and earnings power. Recent research highlights this push and pull, with some analysts pointing to lower input costs and product momentum, while others focus on elasticity risks and cautious profit guidance.
